name: Chennai Egmore platform service

objectives.title: Stop within 2 m of the marker
Wait for the full station dwell
Observe protected traffic on the adjacent track

tutorial: Power moves the train; brake slows it. Speed is shown in km/h.
Wait for your signal to clear. Adjacent traffic has its own protected track.
Berth at the platform marker, hold still for 10 seconds, then press Depart.
Stop at Finish. Review the grade and save the reputation award. Assisted helps with braking.
